say:8:1810414006:0.text: No need to thank me. I have my own reasons for doing this.

choice_prompt:11:1810414009.female: So, we need to stick together.

say:12:1810414010:0.text: That's easy to tell. When I came at you, your first instinct was to protect yourself instead of going all out to fight back.
say:12:1810414010:0.source_cn: 面对我的威胁，你的本能选择是保护自己，而不是舍命反扑。

say:13:1810414011:0.text: Bantus soldiers wouldn't react that way. They'd fight to the death and take their enemies down with them.

say:14:1810414012:0.female: Besides, those statues clearly didn't see you as an ally.

say:15:1810414013:0.source_cn: 如果你还有别的问题，就赶紧说。

choice_prompt:16:1810414013.source_cn: 如果你还有别的问题，就赶紧说。

choice:16:0:1.text: I guess we're on the same side?

choice:11:0:1.female: What if I'm a Bantus soldier?
